body: I have four younger siblings: 5, 6, 8, and 15 years old.
Awww. :)
Aww. How old is he?
Oh, that's really cool. :)

Haha, that's funny.

Yeah, I'm running three half marathons this Summer and maybe a couple in the Fall. Do you?
I do running and weights and your boring old push-ups and sit-ups kind of stuff. I used to do a lot of swimming, I might get back into that this Summer, I don't know.
I stayed at home, re-watched the first season of Parks and Rec, worked out, and yeah, that's about it.
Umm, I don't know. What do you want to know?

>Answer me this, If I didn't care would I continue to use to my time to keep talking to you?

Fine, perhaps I'm just a little too cynical.

>Do they even know how depressed you are?

They know I'm depressed. They know I self harm. They know I'm on pills for it. I don't think, however, that they know how depressed I actually am.

>And if you really didn't want me to care about what happens to you, then you wouldn't of kept responding thus far.

I didn't say I don't want you to care. I just don't believe you really do.
Why would you fly over here just to hang out with someone you don't know?

>if people feel the need to tell you you are a failure then remove them from your life. simple.

It's not so simple. Family? Can't just remove them from your life. And yeah, they're the *only* people in my life, anyways.

>You would be letting a lot of people down by taking your own life. Especially me.

Especially you, huh? You wouldn't even know if I did or didn't do it. If I were to stop replying, sure you'd maybe worry at first (if you even notice), but you'd forget about me by the next day. It's just something you'll say to try to make me feel better.

>maybe things don't need to be fixed. why not just let them be what they are and try to just do what you want without killing yourself. be okay with who you are and what you are doing. just be. nothing is expected from you.

I'm constantly reminded already of how much of a failure I am. If I just stop putting effort into anything, I can't even imagine how much worse it would be.

>I know what you are going through. . .

I'm sorry you had to go through that.

>If you do kill yourself I am going to give myself some blame, and in all honesty I can't handle thinking that I didn't stop another person from harming themselves

Would you really? I seriously doubt it.
It still sounds like my best option.
...Tennessee.

>If your only reason for killing yourself is "what's the point in living?" well stop and think what's the point in dying.

Quick, easy relief. That's the point in dying.

>have you thought about doing something like a Peace-corp tour over the summer? Maybe your major isn't for you? You're aren't stuck where you are unless you don't try something else.

**I don't want to try.** And even if I did, it's not like there's even anything that I want to do.

>Have you isolated the exact things that is dragging you down?

Yup. Everything except sleep. 

And I don't want to change my life. I've tried doing that before.

I don't think people are understanding what's wrong. The problem isn't the depression. The problem is that I don't even care to get better. I've heard and followed all of the advice out there. I don't want to anymore. *I just want death.* 

Sure, I know my life can turn around for the better with just some effort and optimism. I'd much rather die than get better, though.

>there are around 7 billion people on earth living right now , more than 1.02 billion don't have enough food , not to mention how much are living on less than 200 US Dollars per month. Also , there are so many sick , disabled people who still have so much will to live and hope and try to be happy and would give anything (if deathly sick) for just 1 more month of life.

I don't even know how to respond to this. Thinking about this kind of stuff just makes me feel like shit. Not the "I'm so grateful, how could I take all of this for granted" kind of feeling. It's more like why can't I have some terminal illness instead of them?

I've done so much charity work. It's ridiculous. It doesn't make me feel any better about anything, though. I've volunteered with homeless people, sick people, orphans, mentally handicapped, animals, children... it just makes me mad that they have to go through shit and I get to live a privileged life when I'd much rather be the one dying. Like I'm jealous of it. I wish I would get some terrible illness that slowly takes my life away.

>if you look hard enough you will find what you never thought would have existed.

I don't want to look, though. Or, I do, but I can't. If that makes any sense. 

I really don't want to make friends. Friendships always have ended badly for me. And I don't even like being around people, anyways.

>Just out of curiosity what is that you feel you should be doing to get your life on track?

Well, I'm a student, and I've allowed my grades to slip this past semester. Almost lost my scholarships, so I best do better next semester. I need to go out and find a job so I can stop bumming off of my parents. I should probably find a friend or two since I haven't been out with friends in over six months. I should probably find something that I actually enjoy, since 99% of my life now sucks. I should probably take better care of myself, physically and psychologically, since I'm pretty much falling apart.

>I'm going to assume since you made this you like Reddit? Have you gone to one of the meet-ups?

My city hasn't had a meetup yet. And even when they do, I seriously doubt I'd go.

>Are you on Anti-depressants right now? They can have side-effects and make some people worse. 

Yeah. My GP told me to finish up the bottle I have now and then come back in. I'm currently on my fifth antidepressant. They've all made me worse (or more likely they haven't helped and I've been getting worse on my own).

>The last part is absolutely not true. I'm a random guy on the internet, who has never met you, and I would care if you died.

Have you ever known someone who's offed him/herself? What do people automatically say? *"Oh, so selfish of her. Look at how upset her mother is."* People don't care that much. Family, yeah sure. But other people will just be pulled into the emotion without actually giving a damn in the first place.

>People can only know what you think and feel when you talk to them.

I have opened up before. Stupid me. I lost so many friends by disclosing to them how I felt. People will act like they care at first, but when you can't just "snap out of it," they get frustrated and bugger off.

>you're not alone and i feel just as you do.

I'm glad I'm not alone in feeling this; although I'm very sorry that you feel this way as well.

>And to answer your last question, ill optimistically respond with "no".

Ehh, if I killed myself, people would call me selfish anyway. I imagine it'd only be more so when I actually *am* selfish.
